sources.entry: Noti - Receive Android notifications on your mac (with PushBullet).

summary.one_liner: Noti is an unmaintained macOS menu bar app that relays Android phone notifications to your Mac via Pushbullet.
summary.what_it_does: Noti sits in the Mac menu bar and shows notifications received on an Android phone that has Pushbullet installed. Dismissing a notification on the Mac dismisses it on the phone, and the reverse also applies. You can reply to messages such as SMS, WhatsApp, or Hangouts directly from the notification. If a notification has actions, you can run them from the notification, but this requires Pushbullet Pro. The README lists conversation interface and file upload as not yet supported.
use_cases: Read Android phone notifications on a Mac
Reply to SMS or WhatsApp messages from the desktop
Sync notification dismissals between Mac and Android
Keep phone alerts visible while working at a computer
how_to_run: Download the latest .DMG from the project's releases
Or install via Homebrew cask: brew cask install noti
If the install fails, run brew update first
notable: Two-way dismissal sync between Mac and Android
Inline reply to messages from the notification
Installable via Homebrew cask or DMG download
caveats: Unmaintained by the author; maintainership is open to takers
Running notification actions requires a paid Pushbullet Pro subscription
The noti.center domain was hijacked; the GitHub repo is the only official source
